about_the_game:
Scorefall is a calm plinko-inspired roguelite where you drop balls into a chaotic field of pegs, chase high scores, and build powerful upgrade combos as you progress through 50 increasingly challenging rounds. Deep progression systems, strategic choices, and a relaxed lo-fi aesthetic. Chill out and drop some balls.

Drop. Bounce. Score.

Each ball you drop has a multiplier. Each bucket has a point value. When a ball lands in a bucket, its multiplier is applied to that bucket's score. Hit your target score each round to advance.

Choose Upgrades After Every Round

After completing a round, you’ll choose one of three upgrades that modify your balls, pegs, or buckets. Each upgrade has a rarity that affects its power.

Visit the Relic Shop

After every five rounds, you’ll enter the Relic Shop where you can purchase powerful relics using coins collected during your run. Relics provide global effects that can dramatically shift your strategy.

Meta Progression

Every ball you use during a run contributes to your Meta Ball total. These Meta Balls can be spent to unlock permanent upgrades that make future runs easier and more customizable. Increase your chances of finding rare upgrades, reduce your drop randomness, unlock Rerolls and more.

Challenges

Challenges are unlocked after successfully completing Round 50. Challenges increase the difficulty of each run significantly; a larger drop zone, higher score requirements, more expensive relics and less upgrade choices are just some of the obstacles you will face. Completing Round 50 with a Challenge activated will unlock a new Challenge, with 10 in total to overcome.

A local artist and musician created ALL the art and music for Scorefall.

Generative AI was not and will NEVER be used for any art, video or music!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LYS (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ / Vulkan compatible GPU with 1 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Tested on Ubuntu and SteamOS. Other modern 64-bit distros may work but are not officially supported.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M or later
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2 GB RAM
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
